author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: योगहीनसंन्यासस्य व्यर्थत्वं यदुक्तं तदयुक्तम् ।  कामाद्युपद्रवक्षये स्वरूपसुखाविर्भावसत्त्वादित्यतः सत्यं तदेव सुखं भगवद्ध्यानरूपयोगे सत्यक्षयं भवतीति
translation: V. What is favourable: what leads to pleasure. What ...... unfavourable: what leads to pain or sorrow. When this or that befalls one, the mind should not be allowed to be overpowered by sorrow or lay exultation. This is possible for him whose thought is settled. Free from delusion: free from the wrong notion that any one of the world is by himself the free agent in bringing about the good or evil. Knowing Brahman: This furnishes the means of rooting out the wrong notion. It is not sufficient to Know Brahman, i.e., merely to know Him as the only absolute Agent; but he should also stand on Brahman, i.e., must always contemplate Brahman.
